title: Fourier coefficients after parity multiplication
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S,T\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $g$ be a function from the sign cube to $\\{\\pm1\\}$. Multiply $g$ pointwise by the parity character $\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$. The Fourier coefficient of the resulting function at $T$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $g$ at the symmetric difference $S\\triangle T$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ and $T$ are subsets of the coordinates
